nodes.label: hgl game launcher engine (Rust)
nodes.rationale: One dependency-free Rust helper so the Game Center UI only talks to a CLI; state in /dev/shm and a detached watchdog restore gamemode/CPU weights even if hgl is killed.

nodes.label: GitHub API rate-limit fallback (token, releases.atom)
nodes.rationale: GitHub allows 60 unauthenticated API requests/hour per address; hgl sends a token when available and falls back to scraping release pages; never picks aarch64 tarballs.

nodes.label: Lean island mode while gaming
nodes.rationale: While a game runs, hx feeds, widgets, timers and animations stop to free CPU/GPU for the game, then resume.

nodes.label: hgl art (Steam CDN, SteamGridDB cover art)
passman password manager (removed)
nodes.rationale: Removed entirely; existing vault files are left untouched for the user to migrate.

nodes.label: Launcher >do (plain English to action)
nodes.rationale: Clear phrases are matched by rules without the model; the model may only pick from a fixed action list; destructive actions need a second Enter.

nodes.label: qwen2.5:3b-instruct model
nodes.rationale: Chosen after testing against qwen3:4b and gemma2:2b: fastest (3-6 s), most consistent, got self-correcting notes right.

nodes.label: Fact-check filter for local model output
nodes.rationale: Small local models invent numbers/tasks; lines whose numbers or words are not in the source facts are dropped and replaced with the note's own words.

nodes.label: deskCovered (stop stars under windows)
nodes.rationale: Full-screen Canvas repaint cost ~6% CPU; stars became moving scene items and stop drawing when windows cover >=92% of the wallpaper.

nodes.label: Linked widgets (Follow / Right of / Left of)
lockEnv inert lock-screen widgets
nodes.rationale: Lock-screen widgets get the real numbers but empty actions plus a click shield, so nothing runs while locked; private widgets are marked.

nodes.label: Renderer choice OpenGL vs Vulkan
nodes.rationale: Vulkan saved ~80 MB RSS but cost ~500 MB GPU buffers on integrated graphics, so OpenGL is default and auto picks Vulkan only without Mesa OpenGL.

nodes.label: super_tap.sh Super tap with IPC fallback
Root logs in /var/log/halcyon
nodes.rationale: Root-run daemons wrote into user-owned ~/logs, enabling symlink attacks; root now writes to root-owned /var/log/halcyon and ~/logs becomes a symlink.

nodes.label: trusted_file / trusted_bin root-owned check
nodes.rationale: sysmode runs as root so it must not execute user-writable helpers.

nodes.label: Backdrop live-gating idle CPU fix
nodes.rationale: Hidden overlays kept 60 FPS animations running; binding animations to a live property dropped idle CPU from ~60% to 0%.

nodes.label: Inter Variable font instead of Inter.ttc
nodes.rationale: Inter.ttc was mmapped per window (16x, ~196 MB); InterVariable.ttf saves ~187 MB.

nodes.label: LazyLoader for heavy windows
nodes.rationale: Overlay windows only allocated when opened, releasing GPU buffers when closed.

nodes.label: Wallpaper merged into island (one Quickshell)
nodes.rationale: Removes a second Qt/QML/GL stack; trade-off: wallpaper restarts with the island.
